race.description: 2026 Ground Up Maintenance Qld Trotters Oaks (G3)
race.comment: GLADIATRIX (1) is aiming for her second Oaks win after claiming the NSW version earlier this season. Resumed with with a Menangle second in NR up to 54 grade, beaten three and a half metres in a sharp 1:55.7 mile rate, and her previous G1 exposure gives the form extra weight. The kinder draw and strong overall record make tough to beat. Former Kiwi VELOCIS NZ (2) is the most intriguing fresh runner: the last-start Addington failure was poor, yet the prior fourth was sound and a recent Albion Park trial gives Grant Dixon something to work with first-up. DESIRING DIAMONDS (3) brings consistency and a useful Angus Garrard record, though being well held here last start keeps her more in the place mix. SERENA LOVE (6) has been costly with galloping mistakes, but she finished just ahead of DESIRING DIAMONDS last time and Nathan Dawson driving is a significant stabilising factor if she trots cleanly.
